key_insight: DiscoveryRSI turns scientific hypothesis generation into a recursive learning loop that scores, revises, and reuses research strategies to produce more valuable and testable hypotheses.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a practical blueprint for building autonomous research agents that can improve scientific workflow quality over time using structured feedback and executable investigation tasks.
method: Builds hypothesis trees with multi-agent evolutionary search
Compiles selected investigations into executable Harbor tasks
Learns recursively via hypothesis credit optimization, harness replay, and rediscovery
evidence_signal: Across four life-science domains, automated evaluation raised hypothesis quality from 4.86 to 5.39 after two self-improvement rounds, with especially large gains in falsifiability and data resolvability.
watch_item: The reported gains depend on automated scoring and benchmark design, so real-world usefulness may vary without broader human validation and domain-specific deployment checks.
paper_title: DiscoveryRSI: Recursively Learning to Discover Valuable Hypotheses
